C1407.title: Devin Rhoden and Berman Nowlin NFT Rug Pull and Money Laundering Case
C1407.summary: In February 2024, federal prosecutors charged Devin Alan Rhoden and Berman Jerry Nowlin Jr. The indictment alleged that they issued Undead Apes and related NFT collections on Solana and used false benefit claims to attract buyers. They allegedly abandoned the Undead Tombstone project after receiving about $135,000 and moved proceeds across blockchains before converting them to U.S. dollars. Both faced conspiracy charges for wire fraud and money laundering.
